rules.rule: DO canonical authority controls every membership, consent, RSVP and invitation grant; D1 projection never grants access.
Exact persisted epoch/revision/payload acknowledgement precedes outbox deletion; no-op writes retain outbox.
Quota/error rollback cannot partially create messages/promises; retry canonical id/version.
Invite/rejoin floors guard messages, proposals, delayed confirmations, receipts and snapshots.
Checksummed schema/FK-validated snapshot restores into empty namespace only; sessions/reviews revoked and metadata rebuilt.
One issuer has at mostfive signup invite reservations; concurrent/idempotent retries cannot mint a sixth.
Local host-only emulator and denied external fetch; no R2/AI/remote credentials/config/deploy jobs.
Pinned dependencies, valid source syntax, live API/assets and accurate UI role/state before test PASS.
Unique credentials, persistent login/WS throttles, session expiry/revocation and per-frame membership checks.
Local app guards do not guarantee a bill cap on Paid accounts; realFree plan and deployment authorization must be verified before cloud creation.
